baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction "fi qasasihim ibratun" joins qasas to ibra.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sequential trace-following and passage from one side to another combine into an evidentiary route: narrated order carries a discerning reader from events to transferable recognition.

activation_trace.role: Following an أثر makes the narrative sequence a retraceable evidentiary route.
Serially conveyed news supplies ordered links rather than a detached topic.
Passage from side to side makes reception a movement through the sequence.
Making one condition an admonitory analogue of another turns passage into judgment.

changed_reading.after: Their ordered traces form a crossing apparatus by which a reader retraces events and carries their relations into another situation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ibra, tasdiq, and "alladhi bayna yadayhi" stand in one sentence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can describe movement from presented surface to intelligible import, followed by testing against material held in a facing and connected relation.

activation_trace.role: Moving a vision from appearance to meaning supplies interpretive transfer.
Realizing a promise or act makes confirmation outcome-sensitive.
A connection between facing sides supplies relation rather than mere chronology.
The between-the-hands image places confirmed material in an immediate evidentiary position.

changed_reading.before: The account endorses what came before it.
changed_reading.after: The account interprets and confirms material placed before it, while temporal, textual, and evidentiary relations remain coexisting readings.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated hadith yuftara is answered by tasdiq and tafsil.
baseline_models.mechanism: The antithesis does more than label the account non-fiction: renewed report is constrained by truthful correspondence, structural firmness, and inspectable articulation.

activation_trace.role: News renewed in speech supplies the report whose status is tested.
Fabricated falsehood supplies the explicitly rejected production mode.
Solidity and straightness make truth a structural quality as well as a claim.
Exposing parts and meanings makes the report inspectable.

changed_reading.before: This is true rather than invented story.
changed_reading.after: The verse specifies a truth procedure: report must correspond, become firm in realized relations, and expose its articulation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The phrase "tafsila kulli shay" couples separation with totality.
baseline_models.mechanism: A whole becomes intelligible through joints and differentiated parts. Tafsil can make the relevant whole navigable without flattening every thing into an undifferentiated inventory.

activation_trace.role: A joint between pieces supplies an articulated rather than atomized whole.
Clarifying parts and meanings supplies cognitive resolution.
Encompassing totality keeps differentiated parts within a coherent whole.
What can be known and reported defines the objects made legible.

changed_reading.before: It gives an explanation of everything.
changed_reading.after: It renders a whole intelligible by exposing the joints, distinctions, and relations of everything within its operative scope.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The close joins huda, rahma, qawm, and iman.
baseline_models.mechanism: The account is performative as well as descriptive: it gently indicates a way, extends care, and seeks uptake in a social body whose assent settles into trust.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a way makes guidance directional and invitational.
Direction and habitual course make guidance a way of proceeding.
Tender care supplies the account's protective effect.
A human collectivity makes reception communal rather than private.
Heart-settling confirmation supplies cognitive assent.
Security and trust supply the affective settlement of assent.

changed_reading.before: The story offers guidance and mercy to believers.
changed_reading.after: The story tries to form a trusting community by directing conduct and enacting protective care, not merely by transferring information.

context_deltas.mechanism: Scent is sensed, dismissed as old error, and followed by a delivered token that restores sight. The focus account is activated as a cross-modal carrier that can awaken recognition before and beyond ordinary visibility.

activation_trace.role: Crossing supplies movement between sensory and cognitive states.
Finding what is not visibly present supplies pre-visual detection.
Scent supplies the latent sensory trace that first activates recognition.
The charge of deviation makes initial recognition contested.
Casting the token supplies material transfer to the recipient.
The face supplies the receiving surface where message and person meet.
Return to a former state supplies restoration of a dormant faculty.
Insight of the heart lets bodily restoration activate an epistemic analogue.

structural_cues: 12:94-96 moves from scent to accusation, delivered token, restored sight, and a knowledge contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cross-modal recognition and restored sight; I infer that narration can analogically act like the delivered token, while the live alternative confines this efficacy to the narrated event.

changed_reading.before: Ibra is an intellectual lesson extracted by an already capable reader.
changed_reading.after: Ibra can be a carried stimulus that reactivates obscured recognition across sense, affect, sight, and inward insight.

context_deltas.mechanism: Forgiveness protects wrongdoers from the lasting effect of wrong, shelter gathers parents, and subtle care closes a gap within brotherhood. Focus mercy becomes the reassembly and rehousing of damaged kinship.

activation_trace.role: The womb supplies a protective enclosure in which relation is sustained.
Covering wrong while protecting its doer supplies repair without erased responsibility.
Explicit tenderness makes pardon an act of care.
Gathering into shelter supplies the spatial form of reconciliation.
Parenthood and nurture identify the relation being sheltered.
The widened interval between parties supplies the damage to be closed.
Brotherhood supplies the kinship bond that survives the interval.
Gentle beneficence supplies the mode of restoration.

structural_cues: 12:97-100 sequences confession, promised forgiveness, secure entry, parental elevation, and discord between brothers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pardon, shelter, parents, brothers, a gap, and gentle care; I infer that these specify focus mercy as kinship repair, while generic divine compassion remains coexisting.

changed_reading.after: Mercy is protective relational space in which guilt can be covered, estranged kin gathered, and a torn community made livable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A dream returns as realized outcome and is named ta'wil; ta'wil of reports is taught; hidden news is then revealed despite absence from the compact. Ibra, non-fabrication, and tasdiq become an enacted chain from image and hidden event to disclosed report and realized truth.

activation_trace.role: Interpretation of a vision supplies transfer from image to import.
Fulfilled action supplies confirmation by outcome.
Return to an outcome supplies the movement named ta'wil.
The dream supplies the initial image whose import is realized.
Manifesting truth supplies realized verification.
Reports renewed in speech identify the interpreted material.
Hiddenness from sight supplies the epistemic distance crossed.
Divinely given report supplies the disclosed source opposed to fabrication.
A firmly collected decision supplies the hidden human compact reconstructed by the report.

structural_cues: 12:100 makes the former dream true, 12:101 names taught ta'wil of reports, and 12:102 contrasts revealed hidden news with absence from the plot.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dream, outcome, ta'wil, hidden compact, and revelation; I infer one verification chain, while ta'wil as explanation and tasdiq as confirmation of prior scripture remain live.

changed_reading.before: The ending asserts that the story is true.
changed_reading.after: The ending names a process the account enacted: image reaches outcome, hidden event reaches report, and realized relations answer invention.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated forms of the focus root move among not believing, believing while associating, and feeling secure from danger. This splits assent from integrated trust and from complacent safety.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling confirmation supplies the belief named in the focus.
Denied belief shows that narrative availability does not ensure assent.
Numerical predominance prevents belief from being treated as automatically integrated.
Affirmed belief supplies a real but incomplete assent.
Association supplies divided allegiance that keeps assent from whole trust.
Presumed safety activates security and exposes confidence without warranted trust.

structural_cues: 12:103, 12:106, and 12:107 repeat the focus root across unbelief, mixed belief, and security.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated root forms and the association contrast; I infer semantic pressure among assent, trust, and safety, while conventional discrete senses remain possible.

changed_reading.before: The benefits are for anyone classed as a believer.
changed_reading.after: The benefits are received where assent settles into undivided trust; partial belief and unwarranted security remain unstable forms of iman.

context_deltas.mechanism: People physically pass across visible signs while turning aside; focus ibra becomes the crossing they fail to complete. Tafsil counters inattentive transit by articulating the sign's relations.

activation_trace.role: Crossing from side to side supplies completed cognitive passage.
Articulated parts slow a sign into noticeable relations.
A manifest mark supplies what is available to perception.
Passing supplies motion without necessary understanding.
Turning one's side away blocks transit from becoming attentive crossing.

structural_cues: 12:105 places visible signs, passing over them, and active turning away together.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies passage without attention; I infer contrast with focus ibra and a remedial role for tafsil, while the shared motion may be rhetorical proximity rather than designed reversal.

changed_reading.before: Ibra is one lesson among signs.
changed_reading.after: Ibra completes a crossing ordinary sign-passers abort: movement becomes understanding only when attention traverses articulated relations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The declared way is called toward from insight and followed. Focus guidance becomes a socially transmitted course in which seeing, calling, tracing, and walking form one mechanism.

activation_trace.role: A course and manner of proceeding make guidance enactable.
An extended path supplies the concrete course of guidance.
Calling by speech supplies interpersonal transmission.
Insight of the heart supplies the epistemic ground of the call.
Following أثر after أثر supplies disciplined uptake.

structural_cues: 12:108 orders way, call, insight, and followers in one declaration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path, insight-grounded call, and followers; I infer that huda names this social movement, while divine indication independent of human mediation remains live.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is correct information in the account.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is a way disclosed with insight, voiced as invitation, and embodied by people who retrace and follow it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Travel, directed looking, attention to rear trace and outcome, and reason form a field protocol. Focus qasas and ibra become forensic movement through historical remains.

activation_trace.role: Tracking an أثر supplies the forensic method.
Comparing aftermath with one's own condition supplies inference.
Going through land supplies embodied investigation.
Directing eye and insight supplies deliberate observation.
The rear foot and its أثر supply material residue.
The end and consequence supply temporal residue.
Reason that restrains ignorance binds observation into judgment.

structural_cues: 12:109 sequences travel, looking at predecessors' outcome, and a final appeal to reason.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies travel-observe-outcome-reason; I infer a hermeneutic protocol mirrored by qasas and ibra, while it can remain a general command to inspect history.

changed_reading.before: The reader receives a completed story and reflects.
changed_reading.after: The reader retraces a route, inspects residues and outcomes, and binds them into an inference that crosses into the present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence reaches severed hope and unstable judgment about denial before help arrives, separates survivors, and leaves force unrepelled. Qasas becomes a brink-pattern and ibra a threshold crossing beyond apparent causal closure.

activation_trace.role: Approach to death or an apparent end supplies the brink structure.
Passage from one side to another supplies threshold movement.
Cut-off hope supplies the apparent terminal state.
An outcome not trusted supplies epistemic instability.
The truth-falsehood opposition supplies ambiguity around denial.
Manifest aid supplies reversal after despair.
Deliverance by separation supplies selective crossing out of danger.
Failure to repel supplies the irreversible side of the threshold.
Overpowering force supplies what ordinary resistance cannot cross.

structural_cues: 12:110 sequences despair, an ambiguous denial clause, help, selective rescue, and unrepelled force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the crisis sequence; I infer that surprise timing is a transferable pattern, while the denial clause's subject and any generalization remain live alternatives.

changed_reading.before: The stories teach that help eventually comes.
changed_reading.after: The stories train perception at a false ending where severed hope can mark a threshold separating rescue from irreversible consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activates physical cut-and-sew branches beneath terms normally read as narration and fabrication. It is anchored in qasas, yuftara, tasdiq, and tafsil, but should be rendered as a compositional analogy rather than replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus contrasts qasas, a hadith not yuftara, tasdiq, and tafsil.

activation_trace.role: Even cutting supplies the possibility that narration selects and trims material.
Cutting for repair and sewing supplies the rejected image of opaque stitching.
Visible joints supply an inspectable alternative to hidden stitching.
Structural solidity distinguishes articulation from arbitrary patchwork.

changed_reading.before: The account is not fabricated but detailed.
changed_reading.after: The account refuses hidden narrative patchwork: its cuts become visible joints whose solidity can be tested.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: One context use returns sight while another denies that force can be returned. The contrast is anchored in focus guidance and mercy and the repeated root, but should be called a contextual asymmetry rather than an explicit doctrine of a deadline.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus huda and rahma follow contexts in which return is restorative and then impossible.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction supplies a means of return before closure.
Protective tenderness supplies the restorative quality of return.
Return to a former state supplies reversible restoration.
What cannot be pushed back supplies irreversible closure.

changed_reading.before: Guidance and mercy are enduring benefits.
changed_reading.after: Guidance and mercy occupy a live interval of restorative return set against contextual irreversible closure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's form-distant non-dominant ه د د mapping beneath focus ه د ي. It is packet-backed and focus-anchored, but must remain a shadow reading rather than a morphology claim or lexical substitution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet gives focus huda a dominant h-d-y inventory and a non-dominant h-d-d target.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction supplies the overt guidance reading.
Severe breaking supplies the shadow condition against which guidance operates.
Threat supplies the pressure under which orientation is needed.

changed_reading.after: In the contained shadow reading, huda also names orientation that keeps a hearer from being broken or governed by threat.

strongest_changes: Qasas and ibra became a trace-following crossing protocol rather than a detached moral.
Scent, token, and restored sight activated the account as a carrier of latent perception.
Dream, realized truth, ta'wil, hidden news, and revelation made non-fabrication and confirmation self-enacting.
Passing signs and forensic travel produced failed and completed forms of crossing.
Mercy became kinship reassembly, while iman split into assent, integrated trust, and unwarranted security.
The brink sequence made surprise at a false ending part of the transferable pattern.
summary.what_was_special: The focus worked simultaneously as evidence protocol, perceptual reactivation, interpretive verification, walked guidance, relational enclosure, and crisis-threshold pattern. These readings remain multiple rather than merged.
remaining_uncertainties: The shirt-and-sight analogy may belong only to the narrated event rather than narration itself.
What stands between the account's hands may be prior revelation, immediate evidence, or both.
The scope of every thing may be universal or bounded by the account's operative concerns.
The womb-mercy, cut-and-stitch, and h-d-d shadow readings should remain activations rather than replacement translations.
The denial clause in 12:110 leaves more than one crisis reading live.
